name: bld2_mantel_equality_regular
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2) (v : V) : 2 * G.degree v = Fintype.card V
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2) (v : V), 2 * G.degree v = Fintype.card V
informal: Uses Mathlib2.comb_degree_add_degree_le_of_triangle_free (equality case of Mathlib2.bld_mantel_triangle_free): summing deg u + deg v ≤ n over edges gives ∑ deg^2 ≤ n * e; with Cauchy-Schwarz (2e)^2 ≤ n ∑ deg^2 and 4e = n^2 both are equalities, so ∑ (2 deg v - n)^2 = 0 and every degree equals n/2.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2 → ∀ (v : V), 2 * G.degree v = Fintype.card V
